resources.string: sysDescr is the device-reported vendor / model / firmware text; tap a card to expand the full text and raw packet
Scanning — hits appear in real time
All %1$d probes this round got no valid response — a wrong community string, SNMP disabled, ACL blocking or v3-only all look identical
Enter a target and community strings, then start the scan; results come only from real SNMP replies
SNMP v1/v2c only; this page sends v2c GetRequest and does no v3 authentication or encryption negotiation.
Only devices with default community strings (printers / routers / switches / NAS) may respond; a wrong string yields no response, indistinguishable from SNMP off, ACL blocking or v3-only.
sysDescr / sysName / sysObjectID are real device-reported text; unavailable values show \"--\" with no guessing; scanning is single-packet probing with no retries.
[!] Only scan networks you are authorized to test.
▸ Tap to expand full sysDescr / sysObjectID / raw packet
